nodes.label: Resolved rotation velocities
nodes.claim: Orbital speeds remain high where catalogued baryonic contributions decline.
nodes.limit: Distance, inclination, non-circular motion and stellar M/L affect the inference.

nodes.label: Coherent lensing shear
nodes.claim: Background-galaxy shapes carry a projected gravitational signal.
nodes.limit: PSF correction, source redshifts and inversion priors enter the mass map.

nodes.label: X-ray plasma morphology
nodes.claim: Hot baryonic gas is slowed and displaced during a cluster collision.
nodes.limit: Temperature structure and projection complicate three-dimensional geometry.

nodes.label: CMB acoustic structure
nodes.claim: Peak structure separately constrains baryon and cold-matter densities within ΛCDM.
nodes.source: Planck temperature, polarisation and lensing products
nodes.limit: Values depend on the cosmological model and foreground likelihood.

nodes.label: Laboratory null searches
nodes.claim: No universally accepted non-gravitational dark-matter signal has been established.
nodes.limit: Each limit applies to a stated interaction, halo and detector-response model.

nodes.label: Circular dynamics
nodes.claim: v²/r maps an orbital speed to radial acceleration under circular equilibrium.
nodes.limit: Asymmetry, pressure support and non-equilibrium motion can violate the approximation.

nodes.label: Lens geometry
nodes.claim: Σcrit and shear connect projected gravity to source-image distortion.
nodes.limit: Mass-sheet and line-of-sight degeneracies require additional information.

nodes.label: Background expansion
nodes.claim: Radiation, matter and Λ scale differently with cosmic expansion.
nodes.limit: Background evolution alone does not calculate perturbations or the CMB spectrum.

nodes.label: Additional galactic gravity
nodes.claim: A halo term can account for the rotation-curve mass discrepancy.
nodes.limit: Multiple halo profiles and alternative dynamics can reproduce portions of the data.

nodes.label: Collisionless cluster mass
nodes.claim: Most reconstructed mass can align with galaxies rather than ram-pressure-stripped gas.
nodes.source: Joint lensing, optical and X-ray analysis
nodes.limit: Merger geometry, centroid uncertainty and gravity assumptions remain relevant.

nodes.label: Non-baryonic cosmic component
nodes.claim: The CMB and structure growth favour matter beyond the baryon density.
nodes.limit: This does not identify a particle, field or compact object.

nodes.label: Microscopic identity
nodes.claim: Candidates predict different recoil, conversion, decay, lensing or timing observables.
nodes.limit: Gravitational evidence alone does not choose among these microphysical models.
